title: 3.8.7 Lab: Stringify an Object and Spot What Got Dropped
description: Build an object that has a method and an undefined property, stringify it, and find out in the output what JSON refused to carry. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Build an object with a method and an undefined value
steps.instructions: Create a variable called counter and assign it an object. Give it a number property, a function property (a method), and a third property whose value is undefined.

steps.title: Stringify it
steps.instructions: Use JSON.stringify on counter and store the result in a second variable.

steps.title: Log the JSON text
steps.instructions: Use console.log to print the stringified result. Read it and find which properties survived.

requirements.title: Object declared
requirements.description: Declares an object with curly braces

requirements.title: A function value in the object
requirements.description: One property's value is a function

requirements.title: Result logged
requirements.description: Calls console.log on the stringified value
